venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL came in -33.4% vs target on Monday ($841 net vs $1,263).** Food $172. Comps $23.85 (2.8%). 28 guests / $30.05 GCA. **A slow, steady Monday despite a 110 heat index** - some Bacardi friends joined early, then the team coasted into the evening watching World Cup games (lots of engaged guests for the penalty-kick shootouts, 'Penalty Kick City'). Almost every guest ordered food; classic dogs and jojos ranked supreme - a solid Monday for food sales with check averages on trend. Bartenders knocked out cleaning projects; BOH ABK'd the walk-in while holding great ticket times. Fruit flies down significantly thanks to the exterminator and drain enzyme. No Sysco order placed - well stocked. Maintenance: BOH freezer still not holding temp. 86 cast iron (Nixta drop projected next week); 86 Tanqueray. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: chatting with nearby regulars Zack and Ben (adventure gimlets and cognac French 75s). MOD: MKZ. Entered by MKZ.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH came in -13.0% vs target on Monday ($1,360 net vs $1,564).** Food $109. Comps $3.20 (0.23%). 54 guests / $25.19 GCA. **A great Monday** - a slow start gave plenty of time for early cleaning. Annie came in to train and close; she got a feel for the flow of service and met several industry regulars. Kitchen: smooth sailing. 86 Guinness draft (cans available). No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: separating two 21st-birthday groups - fun to be a celebration spot. MOD/Chef: MD / JMS. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR came in -25.1% vs target on Monday ($5,729.48 net vs $7,648.05).** Segments: DC/AM $1,219.69 + D&C PM $4,509.79 (the Total Net Sales field was keyed 'NA' so net = AM + PM; Garden/6A 'NA'). Food $1,655.20. Comps $197.20. 134 guests (Tock). **Slow, slow, slow** - the team cut Kayla early and Justin was out right at 9p. A pop arrived in the 9p hour as expected but not enough to make the sales target. Kitchen: decent night, big thanks to Avery for staying to ABK; not too heavy on prep; the left-side fryer was down (Maggies and Carey aware). Low: honey butter, chicken breast, pasta portions; 86 lamb. Break makeup complete; no-shows not charged; no injury. MOD: Carey (AM) / Maggie H (PM). Entered by Maggie H.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **DCLA beat target +29.4% on Monday ($4,577 net vs $3,537).** Marquee $4,577; Standing Room $0. Food $1,202. Comps $167 (Griffin, Franny, Martin + Dinora, investors/members, birthday, DNL). 107 guests / $91.54 check avg. **Another promising Monday** - started with 44 covers, Xavier training with Angel on the floor. A slow first hour with just a few tables let Selenia, Natalie and Joe assemble the new cocktail menus that arrived in the mail. The room filled around 9pm and stayed full to last call; a brief waitlist was cleared before EON. Great flow of service and another crushed Oyster Monday - 170 sold. Kitchen: another shuckathon. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: regular Jeff ordering pizza delivered to the bar, one covered in truffles. MOD: Joe/Selenia/Vic. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC came in -2.5% vs target on Monday ($4,631.91 net vs $4,751.25).** Marquee bar $4,631.91; Garden N/A. Food $198. Comps $39 (0.84%). 127 covers (33 reservations / 85 walk-ins) / $38.60 GCA. **A hot day with a strong start** - roughly half the space filled in the first hour, full by 7:30 with high energy and strong cross-team communication. A surprise convention at the Marriott down the street drove lots of foot traffic and many first-time D&C guests; it runs through Wednesday, so expect another potential burst then. Late-night industry friends from Matt and Tony's across the river joined post-RAMMYS and called D&C a must-stop. Kitchen: light night, did what they could with snacks. No injury; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: front door lock misaligned (have John look tomorrow). Favorite moment: Ben, Alex and Josh tag-teaming a final Chartreuse M.O.F. sale right at last call. MOD: Josh / Jesse. Entered by Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.weather: Hot, scattered showers early afternoon, clear at night
venues.narrative: **Municipal beat target +3.3% on Monday ($5,167 net vs $5,000).** Segments: AM bar $1,134 + PM bar $4,033 + Sun Club $49 + Hot Eye $0. Food $2,167. Comps $184. Event $0. 104 guests (6 AM / 98 PM, OpenTable). **A slow day until early afternoon, then a great, lively Monday night** - manageable with a small labor force in the morning; the evening had plenty of bar support (ran out of one well) and the bar turned over a couple of times, with a few kooky full-moon characters but no harm done. Aimee kept bartenders stocked; Tia and Eva were cut before 8, leaving the Sams to run as it got busier (James helped run food and bus). Sun Club shut down by a storm; Hot Eye closed. Kitchen: no problems, great work. Maintenance: kitchen line printer not printing and throwing an alert on the computers. No injury. Favorite moment: the full moon brought out characters but it stayed a great night. Entered by James.
